newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon has Middle East's first satellite surgery.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon has Middle East's first satellite surgery.

text.p: A Lebanese surgeon said on Thursday he and a team of doctors in Beirut had become the first in the Middle East to use a satellite link-up for open-heart surgery.

Dr Issam al-Ezair said he and his team consulted via an audiovisual satellite link for more than an hour with French doctors at Toulouse University during a four-hour open-heart operation at Beirut's al-Sahel hospital on Wednesday.

"This is the first time such an operation by satellite link-up is done in the Middle East. Using this technique we can consult foreign doctors on hard cases or transmit to anywhere in the world operations that we perform on rare cases," Ezair told Reuters.
He said the patient, 65-year-old Nayef Wreedan, was convalescing. "The operation was a 100 percent success. He will leave the hospital in five days," Ezair said.
